intro.text: A Ghostblood whom Mraize leaves in charge of the remaining Ghostbloods, reporting to Thaidakar, while he and Iyatil follow Dalinar into the Spiritual Realm.
A member of the Ghostbloods on Roshar, placed temporarily in charge of their Rosharan chapter by Mraize.

items.text: When Mraize left the Physical Realm, he put Zora temporarily in charge of the Ghostbloods on Roshar. It isn't known whether she kept the role afterwards.
